Callout.Name: Suspected Spinal Injury
Callout.Message: Person fallen from a wall, back pain.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, not moved, tingling in the legs.

Script.Line: I came off the wall on my back and nobody has moved me.
There is a buzzing in both feet and I do not like it.
Do not tell me it is fine. Nobody knows if it is fine.

Callout.Patient: My feet are buzzing. Is that the thing you worry about?

Lines.Approach: He went off the wall onto the path and he says his legs feel wrong. Nobody has moved him.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
